# Descriptions
@@ 1
Target is totally protected from all natural light (includes glare, sunburn,
and temporary blinding; but not lightning). This also give a special
modification of +10 to RRs versus light (electricity), and a special
modification of +10 to target’s DB against elemental electricity attacks.
@@ 2
As Resist Light, except protects against natural heat to 200°F and the
modifications apply to heat.
@@ 3
As Resist Light, except protects against natural cold to -20°F and the
modifications apply to cold.
@@ 4
As Resist Light, except all beings within a 10' radius of target are
protected.
@@ 5
As Resist Heat, except all beings within a 10' radius of target are protected.
@@ 6
As Resist Cold, except all beings within a 10' radius of target are protected.
@@ 8
As Resist Light , except protects against all natural light and electricity
and the modifications are +20 for RRs and +20 for DB against attacks.
@@ 9
As Lightarmor, except protects against heat.
@@ 10
As Lightarmor, except protects against cold.
@@ 11
As Lightarmor, except protects all beings within 10'R.
@@ 12
As Heatarmor, except protects all beings within 10'R.
@@ 13
As Coldarmor, except protects all beings within 10'R.
@@ 15
As Lightarmor, except it also decreases all electrical concussion hits (e.g.,
from shock bolts and lightning bolts) by half, and decreases electrical
critical strikes by one level (e.g., 'A's are ignored, 'B's become 'A's, 'C's
become 'B's, etc.).
@@ 17
As Lightning Armor, except fire and heat spells are affected (e.g., fire bolts
and fireballs).
@@ 19
As Lightning Armor, except cold and ice spells are affected (e.g., ice bolts
and coldballs).
@@ 20
As Lightarmor, except as many targets as the caster’s level can be affected.
@@ 25
As Heatarmor, except as many targets as the caster’s level can be affected.
@@ 30
As Coldarmor, except as many targets as the caster’s level can be affected.
@@ 50
Acts as Lightning Armor, Fire Armor, and Ice Armor all at the same time.
